what_happened.line: Commission voted unanimously to adopt a written risk-mitigation and best-practices policy governing its relationship with the private trust company managing its funds.
Declarations of original donor intent are still missing for four of the five trust funds under the commission's oversight, an ongoing research gap.
Chair will send a formal letter to the Worcester Probate Court requesting an archival search for the missing original trust declarations.
A resident questioned the commission on total fund value and investment returns and urged the town to clean up fund management and budgeting practices across departments.
Commission has a vacancy and is seeking a third member with financial, legal, or accounting background.

why_it_matters: The new policy sets how the town's private trust manager handles risk and investment choices for public trust funds, money that ultimately funds town purposes like sidewalks, poor relief, and grounds upkeep.
Without original declarations, the commission and any resident cannot confirm what several of these funds are legally supposed to be spent on.
A vacant commission seat and questions about pooled-fund yield versus inflation touch how effectively town trust money is being stewarded going forward.
